# Wallet Lifecycle Registry (WLR)

Historical registry of cryptocurrency wallets.

Canonical data:
- /data/entities.json
- /data/products.json
- /data/events.json
- /data/evidence.json
- /data/manifest.json

Deterministic derived views:
- /data/wallet-index.json
- /data/product-index.json
- /data/wallets/{entity-slug}.json
- /data/products/{product-slug}.json
- /data/stats.json

WLR does not rank wallets or provide a security guarantee. Stats describe reviewed registry records and are not market-share, safety-score, or recommendation metrics.
